title: Effective read-only batches and gate outcomes

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: Open the demo in Unity with the local bridge running and build mcp-server. Leave a disposable scratch scene dirty so the replay exercises dirty-scene handling without saving or replacing the user's scene.

steps.title: Replay dirty read-only work
steps.payload: Run execute_csharp with read_only=true and code that returns 42 while the scratch scene is dirty. Compare scene roots, dirty state, undo group, lifecycle, checkpoint, and gate fields before and after. Repeat three all-read batch_execute calls containing editor_status and gameobject_find, then run a screenshot-only batch. Do not provide paths_hint for these reads.

steps.title: Replay mutation and preflight refusals
steps.payload: Send a mixed read/write batch without paths_hint and confirm rejection. Send one batch containing an invalid schema, a server-polled tool, a reload-unsafe tool, and an unknown tool; confirm every offending index is reported before step zero. Finally run an intentionally uncompilable mutating snippet with a disposable paths_hint and inspect its mutation and gate outcomes.

steps.title: Expected outcomes
items: Dirty read-only work succeeds without scope, checkpoint, save, undo change, or settle; the scratch scene remains unchanged and dirty.
All-read and screenshot-only batches report effectiveReadOnly=true and need no fake scope; mixed mutation still requires paths_hint.
Nested violations are collected before execution, and mutation failure reports gate outcome skipped with skippedReason mutation_failed and no validation delta.

steps.title: Record response envelopes and scratch-scene restoration

reset.note: Discard only the disposable scratch scene and confirm no sentinel object or checkpoint remains. Preserve all pre-existing dirty scenes and project files.
